verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Inso CLI can run automated test/lint runs unattended in CI pipelines (disabling prompts, returning exit codes), which is a form of background automation, but this is traditional CI-triggered scripting rather than an AI-native, self-initiating agentic automation running autonomously without external triggers. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/triggerless autonomous execution, AI-agent orchestration, or any built-in scheduler for background runs.
